cv.name: Seán Daly
cv.headline: Graduate Mechanical Engineer | Automation & Mechanical Design
cv.summary: Mechanical engineering graduate from the University of Galway, now on a graduate internship in automation equipment design. I paused my studies for three years to care for a family member and came back to finish my degree with a strong final-year project.

experience.title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer (internship)
bullets: Design fixtures and guarding for automated assembly cells in SolidWorks
Run tolerance stack-ups and create drawings to ASME Y14.5
Support factory acceptance tests for medical device customers
Redesigned a gripper bracket, cutting machining cost by about 20%

experience.title: Engineering Co-op Placement – Mechanical Design
bullets: Updated drawings and BOMs for moulded components after engineering changes
Helped validate a new leak test fixture

education.details: Studies paused 2020–2023; graduated June 2026 with 2.1 Honours. Final-year project: FEA of a wave energy mooring bracket

extra_sections: Career break 2020–2023: full-time carer for a family member
